<div class="card-body">
'''Tech Mo'r''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊テック・モア</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「オムニ・ボックス」を使用した直後に、シャッフルしたデッキの上からX枚を見ることができる。X＝同じ位置にいる他のミュージシャンの人数。X枚を見るかわりにもう一度シャッフルすることもできる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Tech-Mor-PSA-160005380.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビス男性のミュージシャン。フィグリン・ダンのバンドでオムニ・ボックスを奏でる。フィグリン・ダンにギャンブルで楽器の所有権を奪われる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tech Mo'r.

'''Card text:'''
Immediately after using Ommni Box, you may look at the top X cards of the shuffled deck. X = the number of other musicians at the same location. You may shuffle again instead of looking at X cards.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith musician. He plays the Ommni Box in Figrin D'an's band. He loses ownership of the instrument to Figrin D'an by gambling.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tech Mo'r]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
